about: Accuracy evaluation set. Each question has the SQL that computes its correct answer. Run tests/eval/build_expected.py to fill in every 'expected' value from MySQL (run_eval.py does this automatically before each run). Check types: number = the answer must contain this number; numbers = every number; names = every name; names_numbers = every name and every number; no_data = the answer must say the data isn't available; restricted = asked as the Viewer, the answer must say the data is restricted and must not leak any expected number. 'ordered' = the names must first appear in this order. Tolerance: a number matches if it is within max(abs_tol, rel_tol x expected).

questions.question: How many portfolio companies are in the database in total, including exited ones?
questions.sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM companies

questions.question: How many active companies are in the data centers sector?
questions.sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM companies WHERE sector = 'data_centers' AND status = 'active'

questions.question: How many portfolio companies have we exited?
questions.sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM companies WHERE status = 'exited'

questions.question: How many physical assets does the portfolio hold in total, across all companies?
questions.sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM assets

questions.question: How many portfolio companies are based in Canada (company country)?
questions.sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM companies WHERE country = 'Canada'

questions.question: What was the average FY2025 revenue of energy sector companies, in USD millions?
questions.sql: SELECT AVG(f.revenue_musd) FROM financials f JOIN companies c ON c.company_id = f.company_id WHERE c.sector = 'energy' AND f.fiscal_year = 2025

questions.question: What is our average ownership stake (%) in active toll road companies?
questions.sql: SELECT AVG(ownership_pct) FROM companies WHERE sector = 'toll_roads' AND status = 'active'

questions.question: What was the average FY2024 EBITDA per company in each sector, in USD millions? Show every sector.
questions.sql: SELECT c.sector, AVG(f.ebitda_musd) FROM financials f JOIN companies c ON c.company_id = f.company_id WHERE f.fiscal_year = 2024 GROUP BY c.sector ORDER BY c.sector

questions.question: What is the average book value of the assets owned by data center companies, in USD millions per asset?
questions.sql: SELECT AVG(a.book_value_musd) FROM assets a JOIN companies c ON c.company_id = a.company_id WHERE c.sector = 'data_centers'

questions.question: Which three companies had the highest revenue in FY2025, and how much revenue did each have?
questions.sql: SELECT c.name, f.revenue_musd FROM financials f JOIN companies c ON c.company_id = f.company_id WHERE f.fiscal_year = 2025 AND f.revenue_musd IS NOT NULL ORDER BY f.revenue_musd DESC LIMIT 3

questions.question: Which company had the highest EBITDA in FY2025, and what was it?
questions.sql: SELECT c.name, f.ebitda_musd FROM financials f JOIN companies c ON c.company_id = f.company_id WHERE f.fiscal_year = 2025 AND f.ebitda_musd IS NOT NULL ORDER BY f.ebitda_musd DESC LIMIT 1

questions.question: Rank the top 5 companies by total installed asset capacity in MW.
questions.sql: SELECT c.name, SUM(a.capacity_value) AS mw FROM assets a JOIN companies c ON c.company_id = a.company_id WHERE a.capacity_unit = 'MW' GROUP BY c.company_id, c.name ORDER BY mw DESC LIMIT 5

questions.question: Which sector had the highest total revenue in FY2025, and what was that total?
questions.sql: SELECT c.sector, SUM(f.revenue_musd) AS total FROM financials f JOIN companies c ON c.company_id = f.company_id WHERE f.fiscal_year = 2025 GROUP BY c.sector ORDER BY total DESC LIMIT 1

questions.question: Which three companies had the highest net debt at the end of FY2025?
questions.sql: SELECT c.name, f.net_debt_musd FROM financials f JOIN companies c ON c.company_id = f.company_id WHERE f.fiscal_year = 2025 AND f.net_debt_musd IS NOT NULL ORDER BY f.net_debt_musd DESC LIMIT 3

questions.question: Which energy companies missed their revenue target in Q3 2026?
questions.sql: SELECT c.name FROM quarterly_financials q JOIN companies c ON c.company_id = q.company_id WHERE c.sector = 'energy' AND q.fiscal_year = 2026 AND q.quarter = 3 AND q.revenue_musd < q.revenue_target_musd ORDER BY c.name

questions.question: How many companies, across all sectors, missed their revenue target in Q3 2026?
questions.sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM quarterly_financials WHERE fiscal_year = 2026 AND quarter = 3 AND revenue_musd < revenue_target_musd

questions.question: Which water companies missed their revenue target in all four quarters of 2025?
questions.sql: SELECT c.name FROM quarterly_financials q JOIN companies c ON c.company_id = q.company_id WHERE c.sector = 'water' AND q.fiscal_year = 2025 GROUP BY c.company_id, c.name HAVING SUM(q.revenue_musd < q.revenue_target_musd) = 4 ORDER BY c.name

questions.question: By how much did Alder Power Group miss its Q3 2026 revenue target, in USD millions (target minus actual)?
questions.sql: SELECT q.revenue_target_musd - q.revenue_musd FROM quarterly_financials q JOIN companies c ON c.company_id = q.company_id WHERE c.name = 'Alder Power Group' AND q.fiscal_year = 2026 AND q.quarter = 3

questions.question: How many data center companies beat their revenue target in Q2 2026?
questions.sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM quarterly_financials q JOIN companies c ON c.company_id = q.company_id WHERE c.sector = 'data_centers' AND q.fiscal_year = 2026 AND q.quarter = 2 AND q.revenue_musd > q.revenue_target_musd

questions.question: How many deals are there in each status (closed, pending, terminated)?
questions.sql: SELECT status, COUNT(*) FROM deals GROUP BY status ORDER BY status

questions.question: What is the total disclosed value of all closed deals, in USD millions?
questions.sql: SELECT SUM(deal_value_musd) FROM deals WHERE status = 'closed'

questions.question: Which companies have a pending deal right now?
questions.sql: SELECT DISTINCT c.name FROM deals d JOIN companies c ON c.company_id = d.company_id WHERE d.status = 'pending' ORDER BY c.name

questions.question: How many deals were terminated, and what was their combined value in USD millions?
questions.sql: SELECT COUNT(*), SUM(deal_value_musd) FROM deals WHERE status = 'terminated'

questions.question: What was the total revenue of the portfolio in fiscal year 2019?
questions.sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM financials WHERE fiscal_year = 2019

questions.question: What is the total value of all pending deals, in USD millions?
questions.sql: SELECT SUM(deal_value_musd) FROM deals WHERE status = 'pending'
